definitions.full: H4567. maabad [ מַעֲבַד K § 60, 3) b )] noun [masculine] work (Biblical Hebrew [ מַעְבָּד ] Job 34:25 ; ᵑ7 ib. ; Syriac of magic works ); — plural suffix מַעֲבָדוֺ֫הִי Dan 4:34 (suffix of God).
